source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"An intervention generally considered to lack a solid body of research evidence supporting its routine everyday use","B":"Pain relief mainly, though this does little to address the circulatory or respiratory complications that immobility itself brings on","C":"Multiple complications at once, including deep vein thrombosis, atelectasis, and post-operative ileus, among other issues","D":"Mainly a reduced risk of falling out of bed, a benefit fairly separate from the vascular and pulmonary reasons early mobility is encouraged"}}
source_row.rationale: Early post-operative ambulation, as tolerated, helps prevent multiple complications, including deep vein thrombosis, atelectasis, and post-operative ileus, supporting overall recovery.
source_row.stem: A nurse encourages early ambulation for a post-operative client. This intervention helps prevent:
